summary: Iteration 5: verified both iteration-5 bug fixes end-to-end. Backend: 28/28 pytest tests PASS against the public preview URL. Regression: /api/auth/login, /api/live/channels (3867 channels), /api/vod/info, /api/series/info, and all auth-guarded endpoints still pass. critical_code_review_comments: server.py:174-194 priority_keywords sort: 'chile' is the first keyword, followed by 'argentina', 'peru'/'perú', 'colombia', 'mexico'/'méxico', etc. The tuple sort key (priority(name), name.lower()) guarantees Chile categories occupy the leading positions and further ties break alphabetically within each country tier — clean and deterministic.

server.py:404-410 resolve(): correctly uses urljoin(final_url, rel_or_abs) instead of naive base+line concatenation. This handles all four HLS URI forms: fully-qualified (returned as-is), scheme-relative //host/path, absolute-from-root /path (the case that broke 216.227.150.122), and relative path. This is the exact spec-compliant fix and matches HLS RFC 8216 URI resolution rules.
server.py:415-423 loop still rewrites URI="…" inside #EXT-X-KEY / #EXT-X-MAP via resolve()+enc() — the fix therefore also applies to segment keys and initialization segments, not only media segments.

server.py:425-432 nested m3u8 detection uses absu.split('?')[0].endswith('.m3u8') AFTER resolution, which correctly routes variant playlists (master → variant) back through /api/stream/hls for recursive rewriting.
Backend file is 529 lines — still under the 700-line ceiling, but the stream-proxy block (250+ lines) would benefit from being extracted into /app/backend/stream_proxy.py in a future refactor.
Live/[chip] frontend: no changes needed for iteration 5 — the frontend simply consumes the /api/live/categories order, so Chile-first is achieved with a single-source-of-truth backend sort.

rca_of_issue: Bug 1 RCA: /api/stream/live/{id} calls _proxy_hls_playlist which fetches the upstream m3u8 and rewrites each segment path to a /api/stream/seg?u=<base64>… proxy URL. The previous implementation used naive `base + line` string concatenation to build the absolute segment URL from the manifest base URL and the segment path. When the upstream server (216.227.150.122 in the failing case) emitted absolute-from-root paths like `/hls/xxx.ts`, that concatenation produced malformed URLs (either `https://host.com:port/hls/xxx.ts` incorrectly appended after the manifest path or with the manifest filename still attached), and the upstream returned an HTML debug page instead of a TS segment — hence every live channel failed to play in the APK. The fix replaces that concat with `urllib.parse.urljoin(final_url, rel_or_abs)`, which is the RFC-3986/RFC-8216 correct way to resolve relative, scheme-relative, and absolute-from-root references against a base URL. Verified by fetching the first segment of channel 803392 and getting HTTP 200 + Content-Type video/mp2t + first byte 0x47 (MPEG-TS sync) + payload >=500 KB. Bug 2 RCA: user requested Chile categories at the top of the live category list for UX reasons. Fixed with a priority_keywords list in server.py:174 where 'chile' is index 0. All three Chile categories are now the first non-meta chips in the horizontal chip row of the En Vivo tab.
